Name: Stardew i18n Translator
Author: Neko41
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew i18n Translator[/b][/size]
A portable Windows x64 app for translating Stardew Valley SMAPI mods. Find strings, edit source and translation side by side, and check protected tokens without working through large JSON files by hand.

[size=4][b]Translation workflow[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Scan your Mods folder, group multi-part mods, and use existing translations. Scanning is read-only.[/*]
[*]After setup, the app opens directly in the translation workspace. Search across mods, use status and validation filters, multi-select, batch actions, keyboard shortcuts, and columns that fit the available space.[/*]
[*]Track changed English strings and review protected Stardew, SMAPI, Content Patcher, dialogue, mail, placeholder, and formatting tokens.[/*]
[*]Use the separate Issues view to inspect warnings, export blockers, and accepted token differences across all translation states. Follow scans, edits, imports, exports, and AI progress in the Activity log.[/*]
[*]Save manual edits, review AI suggestions, import external LLM results, and export target-language files or translation ZIPs.[/*]
[*]Use Files… > Export ZIP for all mods… to create one locale-only ZIP for all scanned mods. Installation folders default to the component manifest folder without outer staging folders; edit them in the preview to match the recipient's installation.[/*]
[/list]The four states are [b]Open[/b], [b]Changed[/b], [b]Review[/b], and [b]Done[/b]. Validation issues are shown separately. AI and external LLM suggestions enter Review and are never marked Done automatically.

To intentionally suppress a word such as an unwanted Tree suffix, enter [b]exactly one normal space[/b] in Translation and save. The entry becomes [b]Done[/b] and its translation cell stays visually blank. JSON and both translation ZIP exports preserve the value as "Tree": " ". A fully empty field remains Open; a later change to the English source marks the saved entry Changed for review.

Saving keeps your work in the app. [b]Export JSON[/b] writes target-language files into installed mods; [b]Export ZIP[/b] creates a locale-only archive to share without modifying installed mod files. Review and Changed translations can be included after a warning, so check those queues before sharing. Blocking token findings require correction or an explicit acceptance of the exact source/target mismatch. JSON exports create .bak backups for existing target files; a failed multi-file export rolls back earlier writes.

[size=4][b]Optional AI[/b][/size]
Manual editing, scanning, glossary building, validation, and export work without AI.
[list]
[*][b]Local AI[/b] connects to a loopback service you configure, such as LM Studio or Ollama.[/*]
[*][b]ChatGPT[/b] uses direct browser sign-in and your ChatGPT plan. No separately installed CLI or API key is required. Choose an available account model and reasoning level in Settings. Account eligibility and model availability may vary.[/*]
[*]ChatGPT can run multiple translation batches in parallel. Choose the concurrency in Settings, follow results saved to Review, and inspect available model, reasoning, and token details in the Activity log. Local AI runs its batches sequentially.[/*]
[*][b]External LLM batches[/b] export a self-contained JSON file for a file-capable LLM. Returned files are checked for stale sources, identities, protected tokens, and existing translations before import.[/*]
[/list]AI instructions preserve the source's tone, humor, emotional intent, and character voice in every target language. ChatGPT quality review is enabled by default and can be disabled for fewer calls and lower time/token use; first drafts may need more manual correction. Validation and human Review still apply.

[size=4][b]Glossary and privacy[/b][/size]
Build optional language-specific glossary hints from local Stardew strings or a compatible installed community language pack. A glossary is never required for translation or export.

Selected English text, limited neighboring context, and matching glossary terms go only to the chosen AI backend. Local AI uses your loopback service; ChatGPT sends them directly to OpenAI. External batches leave your computer only when you upload them yourself. The renewable ChatGPT session is encrypted with Windows DPAPI and bound to your Windows user and portable profile. Moving it to another account or computer requires signing in again. The app has no analytics or telemetry.

[size=4][b]Supported files and languages[/b][/size]
Supports flat i18n/default.json and i18n/<language>.json files, plus split i18n/default/*.json and i18n/<language>/*.json folders. It does not translate arbitrary content.json or XNB assets, manage mods, or download updates.

Built-in targets: German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Chinese.
Custom targets: Vietnamese, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Polish, Finnish, Dutch, Czech, and Thai. Using custom-language files in Stardew requires a matching language mod.

[size=4][b]Installation and updates[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the portable Windows ZIP from Files or GitHub Releases.[/*]
[*]Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder and run stardew-i18n-translator.exe. There is no installer.[/*]
[*]Choose the Stardew Valley folder, Mods folder, and target language. Setup scans your mods automatically.[/*]
[*]Choose a mod in the workspace, double-click a string to edit it, then review and export your work.[/*]
[/list]For updates, close the app and replace the executable and README. [b]Keep the data/ folder beside the executable[/b]: it contains your settings, translation work, and glossary caches. One running app can use a portable profile at a time. If you previously used Codex CLI translation, sign in again through Settings > Translation engines > ChatGPT.

The executable is unsigned, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. If missing, the app offers Microsoft's download page; nothing is installed automatically.
